fact: Statistics Botswana's Vital Statistics Report 2024 describes the Births and Deaths Registration System (BDRS) as a partially automated and decentralized system, introduced in 2003 and run through 35 district registration offices and 17 on-site registration points.
UNICEF's December 2024 report says Botswana has achieved universal birth registration.
UNICEF said under-5 birth registration in Botswana is above 90 percent, a national rate not tied to a digital system.
